name: skemfar shadowsage
mana cost: {3}{B}
types: creature elf cleric
power toughness: 2/5
triggered: when CARDNAME enters, choose one
option[1]: each opponent loses X life, where X is the greatest number of creatures you control that have a creature type in common.
option[2]: you gain X life, where X is the greatest number of creatures you control that have a creature type in common.
